## 席位核对
ACCEPT — PR #36551 @ 49024f4a31 (head of record, full sha on the PR) · card #36472 · L1 first read by area s2-B (area order rule 9) · 2026-11-22T22:52Z

- **Shape:** open, draft, base `main`; first line `Fixes #36472`, delivers both "要做的" items; no closing keyword near another card (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36551` CLEAN).
- **Premise:** held (claim 7084886874), both halves measured by the dev: the drawer's Radix layer dismisses in the document capture phase, and the session counted its own host dialog as a layer over it.
- **Scope:** 4 files, 278+/18-, on the claim surface: `navigation-overlay.tsx` (`escapeOwnedByPaneSession`), `InlineEditSaveBar.tsx` (`data-owns-pane-escape` marker, `escapeOwnedByLayerOver` excluding the dialog that holds the bar, a capture-phase read of "layered at press"), the existing harness test file, one changeset. `RecordDetailView.tsx` untouched (fence held). Not governed, 296 lines. Queued behind s2-A's #36547 on `InlineEditSaveBar.tsx` (overlap-check exit 1 at first push); #36547 merged 2026-11-22T21:34Z, main merged in, both hunks kept (#36547's `face === 'field'` early return and dependency are present in this head's effect), overlap-check now exit 0.
- **Diff read:** the drawer holds itself open only while the bar is drawn; the full page keeps `defaultPrevented` meaning "not the session's" (only `paneHolding` changes it); a popover / select / alert, or a dialog not holding the bar, still takes Esc first.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/36472-preview-esc-ends-edit.md`, read sentence by sentence: "Esc ends the edit and the preview stays open", "the typed change is discarded without a prompt and nothing is written" (the full page's behaviour, measured in the browser), "the next Esc closes the preview (or … goes back one level)", "a popover, select or menu … closes alone", "the full record page is unchanged", and the `data-owns-pane-escape` host note — each matches the diff.
- **Tests and gates:** 8 new cases in `InlineEditSaveBar.test.tsx` driving the real `NavigationOverlay` (no change, changed field, modal preview, level below root, Radix popover over the record, layer closing during capture, not-editing control, full page unchanged); four ablation legs each red (6 / 5 / 5 / 1). Check-runs at this head: 47 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check `success`. Ledger `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36472-gates-ran.txt` (38 families, 0 NOT-MEASURED). Browser: CRM example account and lead previews before/after; HotCRM 线索 NOT MEASURED (repo not in the container) — the example's lead stands in.
- **Card repro after #36547:** a click on a value now opens #36547's per-field editor; measured: Esc closes only that editor, the preview stays. This card keeps the whole-record session in a pane (the area's routing call), which other entry paths still open.
- **Accepted deviations:** main-merge commit pushed before overlap-check (re-run clean after); `ui/AGENTS.md` read after the first edit. A command run by mistake in the area's shared checkout (an unquoted heredoc) was found and killed by the dev; the checkout's `git status` is clean, nothing was sent.
- **Out of scope:** at the drawer root with no edit session, Esc in a plain text field closes the preview — the card says Esc closes the preview when not editing; Acceptance notes, not filed.
- **Landing:** non-governed, ≤3000 lines, K = 7 ⇒ area lands it in this stroke.
